comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a qualifying child takes the 2,200 child tax credit between lines 16 and 24 (3,665 - 2,200 = 1,465); overpaid 4,535. The whole section 152 battery is the filer's own answers; the engine's tests decide the credit. Re-blessed with the earned income credit 345 now computes and joins line 33 (was 6,000, now 6,345; line 34 4,535 -> 4,880) — hand-checked against the 2025 EITC table for one qualifying child: 4,328 - 15.98% x (48,275 bracket midpoint - 23,350) = 345. Earlier, the EITC gate facts (Form 8862, qualifying child of another) were unanswered, the chain resolved Placeholder and the credit was a placeholder 0 — the refundable-side twin of the Form 8960 understatement.
